lessons.runglish: ru-only lesson (profile ru.md §8 'add' / §4.7 / §9): Runglish traps — false friends (magazine/store, accurate/neat, intelligent, cabinet/office, fabric/factory, actual/current, brilliant/diamond, normal/fine), one Russian word vs two English words (say/tell, do/make, learn/study/teach, comfortable/convenient, opportunity/possibility, useful/healthy), calques (feel myself, Thanks God, speak freely, Moscow city) and it for objects; placed after smalltalk via profile.json lessonOrder.after; deck «Ложные друзья и кальки»; no ko-en counterpart (mirrors zh chinglish); its practice set meets the article-plural rule on its own (order 4/4, type 3/4)
lessons.articles-3: ru-only lesson (profile ru.md §8 add, §4.1): «Артикли: итоговое повторение» — articles revisited at B1 in both directions, matching the Russian split of article errors (omission 42% vs overuse 37%, Rozovskaya & Roth 2010): zero article for generic plurals, uncountables and abstract nouns (Cats sleep a lot, Time is money, Life is short), the for nouns defined by a phrase or clause (the music here, the coffee you made) and with superlatives (body only), a / an for one-of-many nouns even with a description (an engineer who…, an interesting article), zero-article fixed phrases (go to bed, go to work / school, at home / work, by train / bus). ko-en has no such lesson. English side (check and practice) copied verbatim from ja articles-3 as profile §8 says, with one localisation per profile §9: Tokyo → Moscow in the engineer mc item (all four options) and the matching body row. Placed after passive via profile.json lessonOrder.after; deck «Светская беседа» (deck 10, as ja/zh).
